name: How do smart home and AV systems affect the build schedule?

mainEntity.name: When should smart home, lighting control, and AV systems be planned in a custom build?
mainEntity.text: When should smart home, lighting control, and AV systems be planned in a custom build?

acceptedAnswer.text: Technology systems should be part of the design conversation very early. In a luxury home, smart lighting, shades, surveillance, audio, networking, and automation all affect wiring, equipment placement, cabinet design, and even ceiling details. If these systems are not coordinated before rough-in, the team may need to open finished surfaces or compromise on performance. Homeowners should decide whether they want a basic setup or a fully integrated system and then make sure the builder, designer, and low-voltage specialist are aligned. The most efficient projects treat technology like a core building system rather than an add-on near the end. That planning protects both the aesthetic and the schedule.
acceptedAnswer.description: Smart home and AV systems should be planned early, before rough-in and finish selections are finalized. Late coordination can cause wiring conflicts, equipment changes, and expensive rework in walls, ceilings, and millwork.
